lines.c1: The biggest token drain is tool output. One test run, one log file or one web page can dump tens of thousands of tokens into the context window.
lines.c2: Context-mode runs the command in a sandbox instead. The raw output stays outside, and only the answer you asked for comes back.
lines.c3: Large content is indexed into a local database, with ranked full-text search.
lines.c4: Later, the agent searches, and gets back only the matching snippets instead of the whole document.
lines.c5: It also records session events: edits, tasks and decisions.
lines.c6: After the context is compacted, it retrieves just the relevant memories, so the agent keeps its thread.
lines.outro: Sandbox the output. Search, don't read. Remember what matters.
